texts.name: Fare zone 1. Journey via this zone charges significantly more.
Outside fare zones Oyster card invalid
Higher fares apply on all trips via this section of tracks.

* Passengers can travel between all rail stations within Heathrow Airport free of charge with an Oyster card or contactless card, regardless of London Underground, Elizabeth line or Heathrow Express. Passengers may also use Hatton Cross for changing trains back to Heathrow Airport without exiting the station.
